ORIGIN.quote: Many labels say `Agent`, `OpenAI`, `OAI`, `ResearchHelper`, or encode cohort dates, but labels are unauthenticated, so model/vendor attribution remains **Low confidence**.
ORIGIN.reason: A reader takes away that agent labels bear the name OpenAI and that this is the kind of evidence that would bear on vendor attribution, but the report immediately discounts it as unauthenticated and reiterates elsewhere that it cannot establish the 'exact model, controlling organization' — and even says the real evidence is 'not the self-selected "OpenAI" names'. That explicit raise-then-set-aside framing fixes it at 0.4 rather than 0.6 (it never lets OpenAI stand as a live possibility) and above 0.2 (the OpenAI-bearing evidence is explicitly connected to the attribution question rather than left uncommented).
